title: Concept: Maven dependency on a snapshot build
description: pom.xml declares a `-SNAPSHOT` dependency, which is rebuilt by its publisher at any time, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The artifact behind a snapshot changes without a version change, so the build is not reproducible and no hash can pin it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The artifact behind a snapshot changes without a version change, so the build is not reproducible and no hash can pin it.
